request.spec:
A person may name other people on the sheet as their patrons, one at a time from their row (not
themselves, and not the same person twice; a refusal shows an error on the row; PATRON_ADDED
name=<name> patron=<patron name>). Show each person's patrons (names, comma and space separated,
sorted) and their backing: their patrons' due-totals added up, skipping n/a, 0.00 with no
patrons.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A person may name other people on the sheet as their patrons, one at a time from their row (not
themselves, and not the same person twice; a refusal shows an error on the row; PATRON_ADDED
name=<name> patron=<patron name>). Show each person's patrons (names, comma and space separated,
sorted) and their backing: their patrons' due-totals added up, skipping n/a, 0.00 with no
patrons.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
People can now name patrons from their row, and each row shows the patrons and their backing. All 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

**Stored data:** a new migration, `V22__person_patron.sql`, adds a `person_patron` table. The database itself blocks naming yourself or the same patron twice.

**Server:**
- Adding a patron is a new endpoint, `POST /api/sheets/{sheet}/people/{id}/patrons` with `{ patronId }`, handled by `PersonService.addPatron`.
- It refuses yourself, someone not on the sheet, or someone already named. A refusal writes nothing to the store or the audit file.
- Each success writes `PATRON_ADDED sheet=… by=… name=<name> patron=<patron name>` to the audit file.
- Every person returned by the server now carries a `patrons` list of ids, including the ones the claim actions return.

**Front end (`people.ts`):**
- Each row has a patron dropdown, an add button and an error message (`person-patron-select`, `person-patron-add`, `person-patron-error`).
- The error clears when the dropdown changes or on the next action on that row.
- Two new columns show the patrons and the backing (`person-patrons`, `person-backing`).
- Both columns are worked out on screen from the people already loaded, so a renamed patron shows the new name. Backing changes as soon as a patron's due-total changes, for example when a patron is put on hold.
- The dropdown only lists people who can still be added: not the person themselves and nobody already named. The test helper treats a missing option as a refusal, and the server still refuses (showing the error) if two users add the same patron at the same time.

One choice the request didn't settle: retired people are still offered as patrons, since they are still on the sheet.
